comment: Recipe classes for which Tailwind v4 (4.2.2, the Web's version) emits no CSS. They are inert on the Web too, so the Flutter recipes correctly ignore them. tool/recipes/test asserts this list matches the pipeline output exactly.

classes.blur-0: Tailwind v4 has no `blur-0` (v4 spells it `blur-none`).
classes.data-[state=copied]:[&_[data-icon=check]: Wraps `blur-0`, which is not a v4 utility.
classes.data-[state=idle]:[&_[data-icon=copy]]:b: Wraps `blur-0`, which is not a v4 utility.
classes.scrollbar-none: No `scrollbar-*` utility/plugin in raft-ui or the Web build.
classes.data-[selected][data-highlighted]:bg-pri: Two bracket groups in one `data-[...]` variant are not valid Tailwind v4 syntax.
classes.data-[nested=true][data-selected=true]:b: Two bracket groups in one `data-[...]` variant are not valid Tailwind v4 syntax.
